results.content: + PNG Sports ### New Ireland Provincial Government and RPNGC partner to train police reservists PNG Sports Home News Preserving Culture in a Digital Age through Theatre Arts # Preserving Culture in a Digital Age through Theatre Arts In response to this growing cultural divide, a group of final-year theatre arts students has taken action to preserve their heritage through the power of performance. Their play, The Fall of Aming, seeks to reconnect audiences with the stories of the past, portraying them in a way that resounds with modern viewers while preserving their cultural roots. Co-writer Miss Naure also emphasized the role of theatre in preserving cultural identity, particularly in an age where other distractions pull people away from traditional forms of storytelling.

results.title: [PDF] Arts-based methods for researching digital life - Rob Kitchin
results.content: Keywords: arts-based methods, research-creation, data stories, fiction, non-fiction, art, film, exhibition, social sciences Introduction Over the last two decades, there has been a turn towards using creative and experimental practices within social sciences research as a means to examine the materialized, embodied, emplaced and experiential nature of the relationship between digital technologies and society. Research-creation in action A variety of arts-based methods can be utilised within research-creation projects, such as the use of creative writing (including short stories, speculative fiction, improvisation and word play, poetry, screenplays, cartoons), producing artworks (including visual, performance and installation art), making data stories (including interactive media, data art, data physicalisation), photography, dance, film-making, creating games, sound and music, and theatre production.

results.title: Coalesce: An Exhibit Where Poetry and the Visual Arts ...
results.content: # Coalesce: An Exhibit Where Poetry and the Visual Arts Alchemize. Art and poetry belong together in an almost “elemental or alchemical” way, according to local visual artist Max Dowdle. On Friday, January 6, 2023, they will celebrate the opening night of *Coalesce* at the Eno Arts Mill Gallery; the exhibit will pair ten Orange County visual artist with ten Orange County poets. Max is the Eno Arts Mill Gallery Coordinator and a visual artist and Morrow is a poet. For the exhibit, the Dowdles paired poets and artists together and each poet created a poem based on a visual work by their partner; each visual artist created a work based on a poem, resulting in 20 works of visual art paired with 20 poems. Max said, “The cross-pollination and the intermingling of the arts is something that Morrow and I both feel very strongly about and being able to create hybrid forms of things is very valuable creatively, socially, and societally.”. For the exhibit, the visual artists were not limited by medium and could submit paintings, photographs, graphic art, or other visual art; one of the artists submitted a sculptural work. In 2009, the Dowdles had previously curated a similar show, titled Influence, in Charleston, South Carolina, which also paired visual artists with poets. For that exhibit, the poets and visual artists were randomly paired and had to work together to create new pieces. According to Morrow, poetry and visual art are uniquely well suited for collaboration because they “have the particular power to connect the personal with the universal…Ideas and imagery can flow easily from the work of art into the poem, from the poem into the art, without either artist or poet [necessarily] needing to be aware of each other’s original thought process.”. Both Dowdles hope that the exhibit will help to make visual art and poetry feel more accessible and engaging. Of poetry, Morrow said, “[m]ost people I know see poetry as something rather academic and staid…The poets who have graciously participated in *Coalesce* all bring personal authenticity, social awareness, and lyrical energy to their work.”. In addition to making art feel more accessible, the Dowdles emphasized how important community is to the artistic process.

results.title: Folklore and traditional performing arts in the modern world
results.content: # Folklore and traditional performing arts in the modern world. But, if you want to learn about folklore and traditional performing arts in the modern world, you must first understand them individually. ## **Traditional performing arts**. Traditional performing arts is a fascinating category of different branches of art that tell the audience stories through singing, dancing, acting, and puppet shows. Whether it’s the graceful movements of classical dance or the lively rhythms of folk music, traditional performing arts allow you to peek into the rich diversity of human creativity and expression over the centuries. In essence, folk performing arts is simply knowledge, culture, and traditions all rolled into one. ## **The role of folklore and traditional performing arts in modern society**. Even after all the changes, revolutions, wars, globalisation, digitisation, and the introduction of AI, folklore and traditional performing arts are still relevant in the modern world. 1. **Historical significance:**Folklore and traditional performing arts act as living museums. 4. **Economic accelerator:**In the modern age, folklore and traditional performing arts are driving the cultural tourism industry by attracting visitors from every corner of the world who want to learn and experience diverse cultures and values. 6. **Creating social awareness:**Throughout history, generations have used folklore and traditional performing arts to inspire societal change, and this hasn’t changed. Folklore and traditional performing arts have changed over the years. ## Frequently asked questions about folklore and traditional performing arts in the modern world. What are traditional performing arts? **A1.**Traditional performing arts are a form of storytelling through music, dance, theatre, circus arts, magic, puppetry, and many other art forms passed down over centuries. Folk performing arts**is a type of art form that combines various elements such as music, dance, storytelling, poetry, and acting. **A3.**The four major traditional performing arts are dance, music, theatre and film. **A4.**Over the centuries, performing arts have also evolved to include new art forms beyond traditional dance, music, theatre and film. Why are traditional performing arts important? **A5.**Traditional and folk performing arts have been passed down through generations and reflect the culture, history, and beliefs of the societies and communities where they originated.
